question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Paranoia
solution:
The correct answer is **'Anxiety'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paranoia **means a feeling of fear and suspicion of other people. (पागलपन)

 
 
• **Example:** "She had been suffering from paranoia and had not left the house for weeks".
 
 
 
• **Anxiety **means Anxiety is a feeling of fear, dread, and uneasiness. (चिंता)
 
 
• **Example:** "she was in a state of anxiety".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2 which is 'Anxiety'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assurance **means a promise that something will certainly happen or be true. (पूर्ण आश्‍वासन)
 
• **Belief **means a feeling that somebody/something is true, morally good or right, or that somebody/something really. (आस्था)
 
• **Faith **means strong belief (in somebody/something); trust. (पूर्ण विश्‍वास; भरोसा)
